description.text:
Radiant (赫) is one of the three booster packs of Sun & Moon: Storming Emergence (横空出世), the first release of the Simplified Chinese Pokémon Trading Card Game. Pokémon Shanghai put it on sale in mainland China on 28 October 2022, a month after presales opened on 28 September. Its cards were not new: for the launch Pokémon picked nearly 1,000 cards from the existing card pool of the Sun & Moon series and split them between Radiant, Verdant (苍), Abundant (泽) and a GX starter deck. Packs held 5 or 25 cards.

Radiant holds the Fire, Psychic and Metal Pokémon and the Trainers that go with them. Its GX cards include Charizard GX, Lunala GX, Metagross GX, Ultra Necrozma GX and Naganadel GX, and it has Ultra Beasts and Prism Star cards too. Its main cards are numbered out of 151; shiny Pokémon, full-art and shiny full-art cards and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 211.

In December 2022 Radiant's five-card packs reached convenience stores in a 15-pack box, which was withdrawn after buyers complained, in favour of the usual 30-pack box. Without telling Pokémon, a distributor repacked pairs of the 15-pack boxes as 30-pack boxes, which were sold at Lawson stores in Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Shanghai from 12 December 2022 to 13 February 2023; Pokémon offered their buyers a full refund.
